description: This PHP script manages the settings interface for module management within the vtiger CRM system. It handles module enabling/disabling, importing, updating, and displaying the settings page with access control checks.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine class instance used for rendering the settings interface.

methods.name: checkFileAccess
methods.description: Checks read/write access permissions on specified files.

methods.name: vtlib_toggleLanguageAccess
methods.description: Enables or disables language module access.

methods.name: vtlib_isDirWriteable
methods.description: Checks if a directory is writable.

methods.name: vtlib_getToggleLanguageInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about toggle-able language modules.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data to prevent injection or security issues.
